zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, sum("a") as "target" ,sum("b") as "b" ,sum("a"-"b") as "result"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE h.hdc_regist=1 AND h.status ='1' and (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

service_plan_province.label: Service plan
service_plan_province.query:
SELECT concat(ar_code,':',sp.splevel) as a_code,concat(sp.splevel,' : ',ar.ar_name) as a_name, sum("a") as "target" ,sum("b") as "b" ,sum("a"-"b") as "result"  FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT changwatcode as ar_code,changwatname as ar_name,zonecode FROM cchangwat GROUP BY changwatcode,changwatname,zonecode ORDER BY changwatcode ) as ar ON left(s.areacode,2)=ar.ar_code LEFT JOIN chospital_regis as h ON s.hospcode=h.hoscode LEFT JOIN ccmihosp as c ON s.hospcode = c.hcode AND c.byear = {{YEAR}} join (SELECT hcode, splevel FROM ccmihosp INNER JOIN chospital_regis h ON ccmihosp.hcode = h.hoscode WHERE h.hdc_regist=1 AND h.status ='1' and byear ={{YEAR}} AND (ccmihosp.region = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (ccmihosp.chwcode = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}})  GROUP BY hcode,splevel) as sp on s.hospcode=sp.hcode WHERE s.id='da16d469ee44ab4ffb28d581353e4ffd' and b_year={{YEAR}} and (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (c.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) GROUP BY a_code,a_name

tambon.query: SELECT     chospital.tmb_code AS areacode,     chospital.tmb_name AS areaname,     sum(A) as target,     sum(B) as B,     sum(A - B) as result FROM     {{S_TABLE}} as s     LEFT JOIN chospital ON s.hospcode = chospital.hoscode     LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE     s.id = {{REPORT_ID}}     AND LEFT(s.areacode, 2) NOT IN('99')     AND s.b_year IN( SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', 1), SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', -1)     )     AND {{YYMMFREEZE}}     AND (left(areacode, 4) = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}})     AND (chospital.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}})     AND (chospital.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}})     AND (chospital.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}})     AND (chospital.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}})     AND (chospital.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}})     AND (chospital.dep IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' = {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})     AND (chospital.mcode = {{MINISTRY_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{MINISTRY_CODE}})     AND (chospital.hoscode = {{HOSPITAL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{HOSPITAL_CODE}})     AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) GROUP BY     chospital.tmb_code

service_plan_hospital.query: SELECT     concat(ccmihosp.splevel, '_', ccmihosp.hcode) AS areacode,     chospital.amp_name AS areaname,     sum(A) as target,     sum(B) as B,     sum(A - B) as result FROM     {{S_TABLE}} as s     LEFT JOIN chospital ON s.hospcode = chospital.hoscode AND LEFT(s.areacode, 4) = chospital.amp_code     INNER JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE     s.id = {{REPORT_ID}}     AND LEFT(s.areacode, 2) NOT IN('99')     AND s.b_year IN(         SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', 1),         SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', -1)     )     AND (chospital.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}})     AND (chospital.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}})     AND (chospital.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}})     AND (chospital.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}})     AND (chospital.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}})     AND (chospital.dep IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' = {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})     AND (chospital.mcode = {{MINISTRY_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{MINISTRY_CODE}})     AND (chospital.hoscode = {{HOSPITAL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{HOSPITAL_CODE}})     AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}})     AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} GROUP BY     concat(ccmihosp.splevel, '_', ccmihosp.hcode)

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT     chospital.zone_code AS areacode,     chospital.zone_name AS areaname,     sum(A) as target,     sum(B) as B,     sum(A - B) as result FROM     {{S_TABLE}} as s     LEFT JOIN chospital ON s.hospcode = chospital.hoscode     LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE     s.id = {{REPORT_ID}}     AND chospital.hdc_regist = 1     AND chospital.status = '1'     AND LEFT(s.areacode, 2) NOT IN('99')     AND s.b_year IN(         SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', 1),         SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', -1)     )     AND {{YYMMFREEZE}}     AND (chospital.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}})     AND (chospital.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}})     AND (chospital.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}})     AND (chospital.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}})     AND (chospital.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}})     AND (chospital.dep IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' = {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})     AND (chospital.mcode = {{MINISTRY_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{MINISTRY_CODE}})     AND (chospital.hoscode = {{HOSPITAL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{HOSPITAL_CODE}})     AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) GROUP BY     chospital.zone_code

moo.label: หมู่บ้าน
moo.query: SELECT     ar_code as areacode,     ar_name as areamame,     sum(A) as target,     sum(B) as B,     sum(A - B) as result FROM     {{S_TABLE}} as s     LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}}     LEFT JOIN (         SELECT             villagecodefull as ar_code,             villagename as ar_name,             villagecodefull as l_code         FROM             cvillage         GROUP BY             l_code         ORDER BY             l_code     ) as ar ON left(s.areacode, 8) = ar.l_code     LEFT JOIN chospital ON s.hospcode = chospital.hoscode WHERE     s.id = {{REPORT_ID}}     AND LEFT(s.areacode, 2) not IN('99')     AND b_year IN(         SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', 1),         SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', -1)     )     AND (left(areacode, 6) = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}})     AND (chospital.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}})     AND (chospital.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}})     AND (chospital.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}})     AND (chospital.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}})     AND (chospital.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}})     AND (chospital.dep IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' = {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})     AND (chospital.mcode = {{MINISTRY_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{MINISTRY_CODE}})     AND (chospital.hoscode = {{HOSPITAL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{HOSPITAL_CODE}})     AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}})     AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} GROUP BY     ar_code
